beats.name: The threshold
beats.note: Read the ground. The first roots wake ahead.

beats.name: The broken reach
beats.note: Scattered eruptions. Read the soil, not a pattern.

beats.name: The old heart
beats.note: Split around the dead giant. Both sides reconnect.

beats.name: The strangle
beats.note: Branching growth closes in. Find a way through.

beats.name: Last light
beats.note: One final weave. The stone gate is ahead.

exportNote: glTF contains a 20-second static snapshot of branching root systems. Runtime animation, collisions, pursuit and portal transport are in the browser prototype; metadata is an integration contract, not native engine code.
